cohort: 57,564 women in Denmark with a cesarean delivery between 1991 and 2000 and no prior abdominal surgery
finding: The cumulative incidence of incisional hernia repair within 10 years after a cesarean delivery was 0.197%, with a higher risk during the first 3 years.
mod_finding: Although transverse incision was the primary cesarean delivery approach, 51% of hernias requiring repair were in midline incisions.
